verses.original: Ὀφείλομεν δὲ ἡμεῖς οἱ δυνατοὶ τὰ ἀσθενήματα τῶν ἀδυνάτων βαστάζειν καὶ μὴ ἑαυτοῖς ἀρέσκειν
verses.transliteration: Opheilomen de hēmeis hoi dynatoi ta asthenēmata tōn adynatōn bastazein kai mē heautois areskein
verses.literal: We who are strong ought to bear with the shortcomings of the weak and not to please ourselves

verses.original: ἕκαστος ἡμῶν τῷ πλησίον ἀρεσκέτω εἰς τὸ ἀγαθὸν πρὸς οἰκοδομήν
verses.transliteration: hekastos hēmōn tō plēsion aresketō eis to agathon pros oikodomēn
verses.literal: Each of us should please his neighbor for his good to build him up

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ὁ Χριστὸς οὐχ ἑαυτῷ ἤρεσεν ἀλλὰ καθὼς γέγραπται Οἱ ὀνειδισμοὶ τῶν ὀνειδιζόντων σε ἐπέπεσαν ἐπ’ ἐμέ
verses.transliteration: kai gar ho Christos ouch heautō ēresen alla kathōs gegraptai Hoi oneidismoi tōn oneidizontōn se epepesan ep’ eme
verses.literal: For even Christ did not please Himself but as it is written The insults of those who insult You have fallen on Me

verses.original: ὅσα γὰρ προεγράφη πάντα εἰς τὴν ἡμετέραν διδασκαλίαν ἐγράφη ἵνα διὰ τῆς ὑπομονῆς καὶ διὰ τῆς παρακλήσεως τῶν γραφῶν τὴν ἐλπίδα ἔχωμεν
verses.transliteration: hosa gar proegraphē panta eis tēn hēmeteran didaskalian egraphē hina dia tēs hypomonēs kai dia tēs paraklēseōs tōn graphōn tēn elpida echōmen
verses.literal: For everything that . . . was written in the past was written for our instruction so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Θεὸς τῆς ὑπομονῆς καὶ τῆς παρακλήσεως δῴη ὑμῖν τὸ αὐτὸ φρονεῖν ἐν ἀλλήλοις κατὰ Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: Ho de Theos tēs hypomonēs kai tēs paraklēseōs dōē hymin to auto phronein en allēlois kata Christon Iēsoun
verses.literal: Now may the God who gives endurance and encouragement grant you harmony with one another in Christ Jesus

verses.original: ἵνα ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐν ἑνὶ στόματι δοξάζητε τὸν Θεὸν καὶ Πατέρα τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: hina homothymadon en heni stomati doxazēte ton Theon kai Patera tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: so that with one mind and one voice you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: Διὸ προσλαμβάνεσθε ἀλλήλους καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς προσελάβετο ὑμᾶς εἰς δόξαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Dio proslambanesthe allēlous kathōs kai ho Christos proselabeto hymas eis doxan tou Theou
verses.literal: Accept one another then just as Christ accepted you in order to bring glory to God

verses.original: λέγω γὰρ Χριστὸν διάκονον γεγενῆσθαι περιτομῆς ὑπὲρ ἀληθείας Θεοῦ εἰς τὸ βεβαιῶσαι τὰς ἐπαγγελίας τῶν πατέρων
verses.transliteration: legō gar Christon diakonon gegenēsthai peritomēs hyper alētheias Theou eis to bebaiōsai tas epangelias tōn paterōn
verses.literal: For I tell you that Christ has become a servant of the circumcised on behalf of God’s truth to confirm the promises made to the patriarchs

verses.original: τὰ δὲ ἔθνη ὑπὲρ ἐλέους δοξάσαι τὸν Θεόν καθὼς γέγραπται Διὰ τοῦτο ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ἐν ἔθνεσιν καὶ τῷ ὀνόματί σου ψαλῶ
verses.transliteration: ta de ethnē hyper eleous doxasai ton Theon kathōs gegraptai Dia touto exomologēsomai soi en ethnesin kai tō onomati sou psalō
verses.literal: so that the Gentiles may glorify God for His mercy As it is written Therefore . . . I will praise You among the Gentiles I will sing hymns to Your name

verses.original: Καὶ πάλιν λέγει Εὐφράνθητε ἔθνη μετὰ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai palin legei Euphranthēte ethnē meta tou laou autou
verses.literal: Again it says Rejoice O Gentiles with His people

verses.original: Καὶ πάλιν Αἰνεῖτε πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τὸν Κύριον καὶ ἐπαινεσάτωσαν αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ λαοί
verses.transliteration: Kai palin Aineite panta ta ethnē ton Kyrion kai epainesatōsan auton pantes hoi laoi
verses.literal: And again Praise the Lord all you Gentiles and extol Him all you peoples

verses.original: Καὶ πάλιν Ἠσαΐας λέγει Ἔσται ἡ ῥίζα τοῦ Ἰεσσαί καὶ ὁ ἀνιστάμενος ἄρχειν ἐθνῶν ἐπ’ αὐτῷ ἔθνη ἐλπιοῦσιν
verses.transliteration: Kai palin Ēsaias legei Estai hē rhiza tou Iessai kai ho anistamenos archein ethnōn ep’ autō ethnē elpiousin
verses.literal: And once more Isaiah says The Root of Jesse will appear One who will arise to rule over the Gentiles in Him the Gentiles will put their hope

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Θεὸς τῆς ἐλπίδος πληρώσαι ὑμᾶς πάσης χαρᾶς καὶ εἰρήνης ἐν τῷ πιστεύειν εἰς τὸ περισσεύειν ὑμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἐλπίδι ἐν δυνάμει Πνεύματος Ἁγίου
verses.transliteration: Ho de Theos tēs elpidos plērōsai hymas pasēs charas kai eirēnēs en tō pisteuein eis to perisseuein hymas en tē elpidi en dynamei Pneumatos Hagiou
verses.literal: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you believe in Him so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit

verses.original: Πέπεισμαι δέ ἀδελφοί μου καὶ αὐτὸς ἐγὼ περὶ ὑμῶν ὅτι καὶ αὐτοὶ μεστοί ἐστε ἀγαθωσύνης πεπληρωμένοι πάσης τῆς γνώσεως δυνάμενοι καὶ ἀλλήλους νουθετεῖν
verses.transliteration: Pepeismai de adelphoi mou kai autos egō peri hymōn hoti kai autoi mestoi este agathōsynēs peplērōmenoi pasēs tēs gnōseōs dynamenoi kai allēlous nouthetein
verses.literal: I myself am convinced - my brothers that you yourselves are full of goodness brimming with knowledge and able to instruct one another

verses.original: τολμηρότερον δὲ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ἀπὸ μέρους ὡς ἐπαναμιμνήσκων ὑμᾶς διὰ τὴν χάριν τὴν δοθεῖσάν μοι ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: tolmēroteron de egrapsa hymin apo merous hōs epanamimnēskōn hymas dia tēn charin tēn dotheisan moi hypo tou Theou
verses.literal: However I have written you a bold reminder on some points because of the grace - God has given me

verses.original: εἰς τὸ εἶναί με λειτουργὸν Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ εἰς τὰ ἔθνη ἱερουργοῦντα τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἵνα γένηται ἡ προσφορὰ τῶν ἐθνῶν εὐπρόσδεκτος ἡγιασμένη ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ
verses.transliteration: eis to einai me leitourgon Christou Iēsou eis ta ethnē hierourgounta to euangelion tou Theou hina genētai hē prosphora tōn ethnōn euprosdektos hēgiasmenē en Pneumati Hagiō
verses.literal: - to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles in the priestly service of the gospel of God so that the Gentiles might become an offering acceptable to God sanctified by the Holy Spirit

verses.original: Ἔχω οὖν τὴν καύχησιν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τὰ πρὸς τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: Echō oun tēn kauchēsin en Christō Iēsou ta pros ton Theon
verses.literal: Therefore I exult in Christ Jesus in my service to God

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ τολμήσω τι λαλεῖν ὧν οὐ κατειργάσατο Χριστὸς δι’ ἐμοῦ εἰς ὑπακοὴν ἐθνῶν λόγῳ καὶ ἔργῳ
verses.transliteration: ou gar tolmēsō ti lalein hōn ou kateirgasato Christos di’ emou eis hypakoēn ethnōn logō kai ergō
verses.literal: I will not presume to speak of anything except what Christ has accomplished through me in leading the Gentiles to obedience by word and deed

verses.original: ἐν δυνάμει σημείων καὶ τεράτων ἐν δυνάμει Πνεύματος θεοῦ ὥστε με ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ κύκλῳ μέχρι τοῦ Ἰλλυρικοῦ πεπληρωκέναι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: en dynamei sēmeiōn kai teratōn en dynamei Pneumatos theou hōste me apo Ierousalēm kai kyklō mechri tou Illyrikou peplērōkenai to euangelion tou Christou
verses.literal: by the power of signs and wonders and by the power of the Spirit of God So from Jerusalem all the way around to Illyricum I have fully proclaimed the gospel of Christ

verses.original: οὕτως δὲ φιλοτιμούμενον εὐαγγελίζεσθαι οὐχ ὅπου ὠνομάσθη Χριστός ἵνα μὴ ἐπ’ ἀλλότριον θεμέλιον οἰκοδομῶ
verses.transliteration: houtōs de philotimoumenon euangelizesthai ouch hopou ōnomasthē Christos hina mē ep’ allotrion themelion oikodomō
verses.literal: In this way I have aspired to preach the gospel where Christ was not known so that I would not be building on someone else’s foundation

verses.original: ἀλλὰ καθὼς γέγραπται Ὄψονται οἷς οὐκ ἀνηγγέλη περὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ οἳ οὐκ ἀκηκόασιν συνήσουσιν
verses.transliteration: alla kathōs gegraptai Opsontai hois ouk anēngelē peri autou kai hoi ouk akēkoasin synēsousin
verses.literal: Rather as it is written Those who were not told about Him will see and those who have not heard will understand

verses.original: Διὸ καὶ ἐνεκοπτόμην τὰ πολλὰ τοῦ ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Dio kai enekoptomēn ta polla tou elthein pros hymas
verses.literal: That is why I have often been hindered . . . . . . from coming to you

verses.original: Νυνὶ δὲ μηκέτι τόπον ἔχων ἐν τοῖς κλίμασι τούτοις ἐπιποθίαν δὲ ἔχων τοῦ ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ ἱκανῶν ἐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Nyni de mēketi topon echōn en tois klimasi toutois epipothian de echōn tou elthein pros hymas apo hikanōn etōn
verses.literal: But now that there are no further opportunities for me in these regions and since I have longed for many years to visit . . . you

verses.original: ὡς ἂν πορεύωμαι εἰς τὴν Σπανίαν ἐλπίζω γὰρ διαπορευόμενος θεάσασθαι ὑμᾶς καὶ ὑφ’ ὑμῶν προπεμφθῆναι ἐκεῖ ἐὰν ὑμῶν πρῶτον ἀπὸ μέρους ἐμπλησθῶ
verses.transliteration: hōs an poreuōmai eis tēn Spanian elpizō gar diaporeuomenos theasasthai hymas kai hyph’ hymōn propemphthēnai ekei ean hymōn prōton apo merous emplēsthō
verses.literal: I hope to see you on . . . my way to Spain And after . . . I have enjoyed your company . . . for a while you can equip me . . . . . . for my journey

verses.original: Νυνὶ δὲ πορεύομαι εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ διακονῶν τοῖς ἁγίοις
verses.transliteration: Nyni de poreuomai eis Ierousalēm diakonōn tois hagiois
verses.literal: Now however I am on my way to Jerusalem to serve the saints there

verses.original: εὐδόκησαν γὰρ Μακεδονία καὶ Ἀχαΐα κοινωνίαν τινὰ ποιήσασθαι εἰς τοὺς πτωχοὺς τῶν ἁγίων τῶν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ
verses.transliteration: eudokēsan gar Makedonia kai Achaia koinōnian tina poiēsasthai eis tous ptōchous tōn hagiōn tōn en Ierousalēm
verses.literal: For Macedonia and Achaia were pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the saints in Jerusalem

verses.original: εὐδόκησαν γάρ καὶ ὀφειλέται εἰσὶν αὐτῶν εἰ γὰρ τοῖς πνευματικοῖς αὐτῶν ἐκοινώνησαν τὰ ἔθνη ὀφείλουσιν καὶ ἐν τοῖς σαρκικοῖς λειτουργῆσαι αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: eudokēsan gar kai opheiletai eisin autōn ei gar tois pneumatikois autōn ekoinōnēsan ta ethnē opheilousin kai en tois sarkikois leitourgēsai autois
verses.literal: They were pleased to do it and indeed they owe it to them For if the Gentiles have shared in their spiritual blessings they are obligated . . . to minister to them with material blessings

verses.original: Τοῦτο οὖν ἐπιτελέσας καὶ σφραγισάμενος αὐτοῖς τὸν καρπὸν τοῦτον ἀπελεύσομαι δι’ ὑμῶν εἰς Σπανίαν
verses.transliteration: Touto oun epitelesas kai sphragisamenos autois ton karpon touton apeleusomai di’ hymōn eis Spanian
verses.literal: So after I have completed this service and have safely delivered this bounty to them I will set off to Spain by way of you

verses.original: οἶδα δὲ ὅτι ἐρχόμενος πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν πληρώματι εὐλογίας Χριστοῦ ἐλεύσομαι
verses.transliteration: oida de hoti erchomenos pros hymas en plērōmati eulogias Christou eleusomai
verses.literal: I know that when I come to you I will come in the fullness of the blessing of Christ

verses.original: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί διὰ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ διὰ τῆς ἀγάπης τοῦ Πνεύματος συναγωνίσασθαί μοι ἐν ταῖς προσευχαῖς ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ πρὸς τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: Parakalō de hymas adelphoi dia tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou kai dia tēs agapēs tou Pneumatos synagōnisasthai moi en tais proseuchais hyper emou pros ton Theon
verses.literal: Now I urge you brothers by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit to join me in my struggle . . . by praying to God for me

verses.original: ἵνα ῥυσθῶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀπειθούντων ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ καὶ ἡ διακονία μου ἡ εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ εὐπρόσδεκτος τοῖς ἁγίοις γένηται
verses.transliteration: hina rhysthō apo tōn apeithountōn en tē Ioudaia kai hē diakonia mou hē eis Ierousalēm euprosdektos tois hagiois genētai
verses.literal: Pray that I may be delivered from the unbelievers in Judea and that my service in Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints there

verses.original: ἵνα ἐν χαρᾷ ἐλθὼν πρὸς ὑμᾶς διὰ θελήματος Θεοῦ συναναπαύσωμαι ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: hina en chara elthōn pros hymas dia thelēmatos Theou synanapausōmai hymin
verses.literal: so that by God’s will I may come to you with joy and together with you be refreshed . . .

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: Ho de Theos tēs eirēnēs meta pantōn hymōn amēn
verses.literal: The God of peace be with all of you Amen
